post.summary: Cancel the waiting models of a processing run
post.description: Cancels every model execution of the run that has not started computing (pending, or queued and never handed to study-service) and returns the run detail. Executions already handed to study-service are not interrupted: they finish and record their result, after which the run becomes terminal. The run ends CANCELLED when no model completed and PARTIAL_SUCCESS when at least one did. Idempotent: a run that already ended, or was already cancelled, returns 200 with its current state. After a cancellation, automatic ingestion does not start a new automatic run for the study; a manual reprocess or a viewer run still does. Takes no request body. Callable by any authenticated tenant user who accepted the current policies; the user and time are recorded on the run.

409.description: PROCESSING_RUN_NOT_CANCELLABLE: every remaining model of the run is already computing

post.summary: Run one model on a study from the viewer
post.description: Creates one VIEWER_REQUEST processing run with a single execution for one model and dispatches it through study-service like a manual reprocess, so it appears in run history and worklist events. Callable by any authenticated tenant user who accepted the current policies (same as interactive predict); reserves one unit of the user's inference quota, refunded if dispatch never starts. Works for studies never ingested by a job: the candidate (and, if the tenant has no ingestion job for the model version, a STOPPED viewer-owned ingestion job) is created. The study must be stored in the local Orthanc. modelId is the Firestore registration ID; the container ID or the model-info modelId are also accepted. seriesInstanceUIDs is accepted but study-service currently selects the series itself.

get.summary: Get the live activity of the chat request in flight
get.description: Returns the steps the chat assistant has taken so far for the chat request currently running on this thread (one step per tool call and per delegation to a specialist), in the order they started. Poll it about once a second while POST /orchestrator/threads/{threadID}/chat is pending. Step labels are built by the chat service from the tool and a validated model name only: they never contain tool arguments, patient or study identifiers, file paths or search queries. The chat service only answers for the user and tenant that started the request; otherwise, or when no request is running, the response is 200 with active false and no steps. A request that just finished stays readable for a few seconds with active false. Same authentication as the sibling thread routes. The response of POST /orchestrator/threads/{threadID}/chat carries the completed steps in an optional activity field with the ChatActivity shape.

200.description: Steps so far of the chat request in flight

404.description: The chat service does not support progress (older version); errorCode chat_progress_unsupported. Clients fall back to a plain waiting indicator.

502.description: The chat service could not be reached; errorCode chat_progress_unavailable

id.description: Position of the step in the request, starting at 1.

key.description: Stable machine key of the step, for translation: delegate_angiogram, delegate_echo, delegate_ecg, delegate_web, delegate, model_result, model_result_or_run, run_model, study_models, all_model_results, coronary_findings, verify_study, web_search, web_read, read_reference, plan, tool.

label.description: English, clinician-readable label. Never contains tool arguments or identifiers.

model.description: Validated model name the step concerns, when any.

active.description: True only while a chat request is running on the thread.

executionId.description: Optional: execution whose change produced this event

status.description: Optional: execution status after the change

notify.description: Whether the connected user should get a notification (bell entry / toast) for this event. Automatic runs notify the creators of their ingestion jobs that have notifications on, plus ADMIN/OWNER users, unless the user muted automatic runs (user metadata notifyAutomaticRuns=false, read when the stream opens); other runs notify only the user who launched them. Status updates must be applied whatever its value.

cancelledByYou.description: True when the connected user cancelled this run.

cancellable.description: True while the run is active and at least one model has not started computing, so POST .../cancel would cancel something.

cancelledAt.description: When a user cancelled the run's waiting models. Absent otherwise.

waitingReason.description: Why an active run is not computing. study_growing: the remaining models wait for the study to stop receiving images (reported by the run-detail endpoint only). stale: the remaining models were never started and the run carries PENDING_STALE or EXPECTED_JOB_MISSING. Absent while a model is running, or when the run is merely queued.

stableAfter.description: With waitingReason study_growing: the earliest time the study is considered stable if no further image arrives.

SelectedViews.description: Views the model actually used. null means the run did not record its selection.

modelId.description: Firestore registration ID of the matching tenant model

executionId.description: null means use the legacy job report route

dispatchSeriesInstanceUIDs.description: Optional. Series Instance UIDs the run was dispatched with, passed through from study-service. A run requested from the viewer records its list whether or not the user picked series; null means no list was recorded and the run used every series of the modality. Omitted when study-service does not report the field.

inputVideoCount.description: Optional. Videos the run was given. Omitted when the run recorded none.

eligibleVideoCount.description: Optional. Videos the run could use; the best-run rule compares this count. Omitted when the run recorded none.

runs.description: Optional. The model's completed runs for the study, newest first (at most 20), the reported run included. The result itself stays the best run (most eligible videos; the newest on a tie or unknown count); the list lets a client show another run, for example a rerun requested from the viewer on fewer series. Omitted when study-service does not list runs. Listed runs carry no runs of their own.

bestRun.description: Set on listed runs only: true for the run reported as the result.

labels.description: Labels of the run as typed, oldest first (PACS-447); empty when it has none. Automatic angiogram runs carry DIAGNOSTIC by default.

label.description: The label filter, as asked; omitted without one.

modelVersion.description: Version of the container that rendered the report

modality.description: DICOM modality, required only for models supporting several modalities

result.description: Opaque model-specific JSON. Consumers must not assume one shared model schema.

notificationsEnabled.description: Optional. Whether runs started by this job notify its creator and workspace admins. Defaults to true.

turnstileToken.description: Single-use Turnstile token. Omit until the server returns LOGIN_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED or data.challengeRequired=true.

seriesInstanceUIDs.description: Must also satisfy the selected model's authoritative dicomUploadMin/dicomUploadMax range.

additionalMetadata.description: Bounded by encoded size, nesting depth, and entry count.

turnstileToken.description: Single-use Cloudflare Turnstile response generated for this registration attempt.

password.description: Must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one special character.

policyAcceptances.description: Exact current policy identifiers and versions obtained from /user/policies/registration.

reason.description: Optional administrative reason recorded in the audit trail.

notificationsEnabled.description: Optional. Omit to keep the current value.

WorklistOffset.description: Zero-based number of records to skip.
